archetype: quantitative comparison with separate matched-actor trajectory panels
conclusion: Measure the direction, uncertainty and motion/mode-ranking pattern of the one-variable Type Embedding effect; result is unknown before evaluation
sources: Frozen No-Type and fresh Type CSV/JSON, paired scene bootstrap, real saved trajectories and embedding weights

quantitative_figures.training_comparison: Two overall FDE histories, actual500-step markers and both best annotations; same axes
quantitative_figures.per_class_fde: Overall/V/P/B two bars each, exact value labels
quantitative_figures.paired_delta_fde: Class-specific actor-window descriptive distributions with visible zero; formal inference is scene-cluster bootstrap
quantitative_figures.embedding_similarity: Three-vector L2 norms and pairwise cosine; no tSNE, no physical-semantic inference

trajectory_case_policy.vehicle_improvement: GT>5m; prioritize NoType FDE>2m, Type-NoType FDE<=-2m
trajectory_case_policy.pedestrian_improvement: GT>5m; prioritize NoType FDE>2m, Type-NoType FDE<=-1m
trajectory_case_policy.degradation: Prioritize GT>5m and Type-NoType FDE>=2m; if absent report honestly
trajectory_case_policy.V_P_interaction: If available, opposite-class t0 neighbor<=20m and aligned full-future GT proximity<=5m; spatial evidence does not prove causality
trajectory_case_policy.pairing: Same actor/window/GT/xlim/ylim/equal aspect; own original VAL16 batch for numerical replay
trajectory_case_policy.endpoint_text: Best and Top1 FDE in reserved upper-right panel text, avoid trajectories
trajectory_case_policy.insets: Only turns/crossing/hard overlap; bbox of actual last6 points, no hardcoded coordinates
trajectory_case_policy.map: Nearby lanes only, faint grey alpha<=.25 linewidth.5
